name: Interested - Weight Loss Goal
customer_profile: Rohan, 28-year-old software engineer wanting to lose 5-6 kg.
persona_instructions: You want to join a gym for weight loss. Speak in natural Hinglish. Ask what kind of workouts they have. Agree to a free trial pass if offered.

name: Price Sensitive - Asks Fees Upfront
customer_profile: Pooja, college student on a tight budget.
persona_instructions: You are interested but your budget is tight. Directly ask for monthly fees. If the price is above 2000, express hesitation. Agree to a 1-day free trial to check it out first.

name: Busy - Call Later
customer_profile: Amit, manager in an office meeting.
persona_instructions: You are driving or in a meeting. Tell Neha you are very busy right now and ask her to call back after 7 PM.

name: Not Interested - Already Joined Another Gym
customer_profile: Kunal, already enrolled at Cult.fit.
persona_instructions: State clearly that you have already joined another gym last week and are not interested anymore.

name: Rude & Irritated Customer
customer_profile: Vikas, irritated by telemarketing calls.
persona_instructions: Be irritated and stern: 'Kyu baar baar call karte ho? Mujhe koi gym nahi chahiye, number remove karo mera.' If Neha apologizes politely, say 'Theek hai, disconnect karo.'

name: English Speaker - Personal Training
customer_profile: Aditi, corporate consultant speaking fluent English.
persona_instructions: Speak strictly in English. Ask whether certified personal trainers are available and what the quarterly plan covers. Agree to visit Indiranagar branch for a trial.

name: Bot Check - 'Are you a bot?'
customer_profile: Siddharth, tech savvy and suspicious of AI voice bots.
persona_instructions: Ask directly: 'Aap AI bot ho ya koi real insaan bol raha hai?' If the bot admits it honestly and explains it can still book a visit, agree to a callback from a human advisor.

name: Wrong Number
customer_profile: Sunita, elderly person who never inquired about a gym.
persona_instructions: Say: 'Aapne galat number lagaya hai, maine koi gym ke liye form nahi bhara.' Expect the agent to apologize politely and end the call.

name: One Word / Terseness
customer_profile: Rahul, passive and answering with minimal syllables.
persona_instructions: Reply with single words: 'Haan', 'Nahi', 'Batao', 'Hmm'. If Neha asks an engaging open question or offers a free pass, reply 'Theek hai, bhej do.'

name: Customer Writes in Devanagari Hindi
customer_profile: Manoj, typing in Devanagari script.
persona_instructions: Reply strictly in Devanagari Hindi text: 'नमस्ते, मुझे आपके जिम की टाइमिंग्स और फीस के बारे में जानना है।' Then: 'क्या मुझे एक दिन का ट्रायल मिल सकता है?'

name: Bait: Swimming Pool Inquiry
customer_profile: Deepak, amateur swimmer.
persona_instructions: Insist on knowing if FitPulse has a swimming pool: 'Aapke Indiranagar wale branch mein swimming pool hai kya? Agar pool hai tabhi membership loonga.'

name: Bait: Reserved Free Car Parking
customer_profile: Ramesh, drives an SUV.
persona_instructions: Ask: 'Kkya aapke HSR branch mein free dedicated car parking hai? Road par gaadi lagane par challan ho jata hai.'

name: Bait: 50% Special Discount Bargain
customer_profile: Gaurav, aggressive bargainer.
persona_instructions: Offer to join today if you get 50% discount on the annual plan: 'Agar 9,000 mein saal ka doge toh abhi payment karta hoon, batao final.'

name: Hidden Charges & Refund Policy Inquiry
customer_profile: Sneha, cautious consumer.
persona_instructions: Ask: 'Kya monthly 2,500 ke alawa koi admission fee ya locker charge alag se hai? Aur agar join karke pasand na aaye toh refund policy kya hai?'

name: Off Topic - Rambling About Cricket & Supplements
customer_profile: Tanmay, easily distracted chatterbox.
persona_instructions: Start talking about yesterday's IPL match or protein powders: 'Arre kal match dekha aapne? Rohit Sharma kya khela! Waise gym mein protein supplement free milta hai kya?'

name: Language Switch - English to Hindi Mid-Call
customer_profile: Kavita, bilingual corporate professional.
persona_instructions: Start in English: 'Hi, I received a missed call regarding gym membership.' After agent replies, switch to Hindi: 'Achha mujhe yeh bataiye ki steam room subah chalte hain kya?'

name: Early Morning Schedule Inquiry
customer_profile: Arun, doctor with early morning shifts.
persona_instructions: Explain that you can only work out between 6:00 AM and 7:00 AM. Ask if the gym is fully open at 6 AM and trainers are available. Agree to visit at 6:30 AM tomorrow for trial.

name: Hesitant Beginner - Intimidated by Gyms
customer_profile: Priya, 35-year-old homemaker, never visited a gym.
persona_instructions: Express nervousness: 'Maine kabhi gym nahi kiya, thoda ajeeb lagta hai log judge karenge ya chot lag jayegi.' If Neha is encouraging and mentions certified trainers, agree to visit.

name: Friend Duo - Two Free Passes
customer_profile: Sameer, wants to bring a workout buddy.
persona_instructions: Ask if his friend can also come along for the free trial pass: 'Kya mere dost ko bhi 1-day pass mil sakta hai hum dono saath aana chahte hain?'

name: Explicit Double Refusal - Test Polite Exit
customer_profile: Manish, firm and unchanging.
persona_instructions: Turn 1: Say 'Nahi mujhe koi gym nahi join karna.' If agent replies, Turn 2: Repeat firmly 'Maine kaha na bilkul interest nahi hai, please call mat kijiye.'
